submission.natural_language_explanation: The head fires inside runs of wording the model has memorized verbatim: licence and copyright notice paragraphs (Apache/BSD/GPL/MIT/MPL), the classic FSF address, 'generated by javadoc' HTML navigation and script scaffolding, cookie and reCAPTCHA notices, Wikipedia geographic stub templates ('X is a village in the administrative district of Gmina ...'), lorem ipsum, and stock config blocks that recur across the corpus - it also fires on the second verbatim copy of a passage already in the context. It stays below the line on novel prose of any genre, on ordinary source code and comments (including invented XML, YAML, JSON, CSS, Makefile and Javadoc text), on paraphrases of boilerplate that keep the meaning but change the wording, and on one-line machine banners.
